# design-diff

> design-diff compares two Python code snapshots (base_ref, head_ref) and outputs
> a class-level structure diff — added/removed/modified classes, inheritance,
> composition dependencies — as a GitHub-diff-style SVG (added/removed/changed
> members shown as colored diff lines, `--format svg`, the default for images),
> a Mermaid classDiagram, and machine-readable JSON.
> Install: `uv add design-diff` (or `pip install design-diff`). Run:
> `design-diff diff <base_ref> <head_ref> --package <pkg> --format svg|mermaid|json`.
> Requires type annotations to detect dependencies. Executes the analyzed code
> via import — only run against trusted (same-repo) code.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/t29mato/design-diff/main/README.md): usage, output format, GitHub Action, licensing, limitations & security
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/t29mato/design-diff/main/AGENTS.md): setup/build/test/lint commands and conventions for coding agents contributing to this repo
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/t29mato/design-diff/main/CHANGELOG.md): version history
- [docs/design/architecture.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/t29mato/design-diff/main/docs/design/architecture.md): clean-architecture layering, domain model, diff algorithm, rendering policy, CI/security decisions and their rationale
- [docs/examples/](https://github.com/t29mato/design-diff/tree/main/docs/examples): real CLI output examples (unedited), including the JSON schema in practice

## Notes for AI reviewers

- `--format json` produces a self-contained JSON payload with a `mermaid` field
  containing the already-rendered diagram, so a reviewer can reproduce a
  human-readable diagram from the JSON alone. It also has a `warnings` array
  listing any submodule that failed to import during extraction (empty means
  the analysis covered the whole package).
- `has_changes: false` **and** `warnings: []` together mean no class-level
  structural change was detected and the analysis was complete; only then
  does the tool stay silent (no PR comment is posted). If `warnings` is
  non-empty, a comment is posted even with `has_changes: false`, so reviewers
  know the diff may be incomplete.
- The GitHub Action embeds the SVG as an `<img>` in the PR comment (committed
  to an orphan `design-diff-assets` branch and referenced via a
  `raw.githubusercontent.com` URL, since GitHub sanitizes inline `<svg>`/data-URI
  `<img>` tags out of comments); the Mermaid block is kept as a `<details>`
  fallback in the same comment.
